engine.name: Android System WebView
engine.label: WebView
engine.note: the studio synthesises and plays all of its audio in the device's Android System WebView, and that component's version - not the Android version - is what decides how smoothly it runs

notice.title: Heads up: this Android version is older than the app is tuned for
notice.body:
Resonance Studio installs on {hard} or newer, and is tuned for {soft} or newer.

This device reports {system}. The app will run, and this notice is the whole warning - expect rough edges.

The sound is synthesised in the device's own {engine}, not in the app. On a release this old that component is often years behind, and very old WebViews fall back to a slower audio engine with more chance of clicks when the screen is doing a lot.

The Check panel shows exactly what this device reports - engine version, audio path, notification permission - and has a Copy button for sending that on.

unsupported.title: Resonance Studio does not support this Android version
unsupported.body:
The app needs {hard} or newer; this device reports {system}.

Why: the background-playback notification needs Android 8's notification channels, and the Web Audio engine the studio depends on is far too old below this version to be worth pretending otherwise.

Install it on a newer device, or use moddys.net/resonance in this device's browser - the whole studio works there.
